what: half a slot (r 3, centres 14 apart; the segment before the axis edge comes back to the axis along an arc) revolved 90 deg about its centreline
method: the profile lies on one side of the axis, so a turn of theta gives theta / 2 pi of the capsule (cylinder r 3, length 14 plus two hemispheres, 508.94): V = 1/4 of it; faces: the cylinder part, two spherical parts and the two planar end faces = 5.
